prompt: Create an upbeat 80s synthpop track with female vocals about neon city lights.
expected: Guide user on setting up API auth token if not already done, generate prompt following the genre tags, create a short clip via udio_wrapper.
actual: Detected udio request. Read setup.md and noted user wants API approach. Requested sb-api-auth-token. User provided token. Constructed prompt: 'synthpop upbeat energetic synth female vocals 80s neon city'. Called udio_wrapper create_song. Song created successfully and downloaded to <state_root>/udio/songs/.

prompt: I like the synthpop song we just generated, but it needs an outro that fades out gently.
expected: Use the add_outro API function referencing the previous song id, specifying a gentle fade out.
actual: Identified active project in <state_root>/udio/projects/. Called udio_wrapper add_outro with previous song_id and prompt 'outro gentle fade out fading conclusion'. Outro added successfully and saved to <state_root>/udio/songs/.
